title: Tajweed recitation check: hamzat al-wasl, alif-lam and waqf: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-Qiyamah, hamzat al-wasl and alif-lam
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 38 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Tajweed recitation check rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 38. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ (٢٠) وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ (٢١) وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاضِرَةٌ (٢٢) إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌۭ (٢٣) وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌۭ (٢٤) تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌۭ (٢٥) كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ (٢٦) وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍۢ (٢٧) وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ (٢٨) وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ (٢٩) إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ (٣٠)

head: Part
Task
rows: How do you stop? (4 ayah ends)

keywords.def: a joining hamza: said only when we start with it, dropped when joined
sun letter: the laam of al- is silent and the next letter doubles
moon letter: the laam of al- is said with a sukoon
stopping on a word, with a breath

questions.q: Chain recitation: each pupil recites one ayah of Al-Qiyamah 75:1-40 in register order.
questions.a: 75:1-40 recited in order by the class.

questions.q: Check: today's group recites 75:20 to 40 to the teacher, starting where the teacher says. Everyone else completes the written check on the pupil PDF.
questions.a: Rubric and written check marked; one target each.

questions.q: Extend: write your target in the portal response box.
questions.a: For example: 'Start verbs with the correct vowel every time.'
A) al-aakhirah. Al- always starts with a fathah.

questions.q: Think again: Which rule from this half term do you now apply without thinking?
questions.a: Answers vary: sun and moon letters, the saktah, starting with hamzat al-wasl.
